about_the_game:
This is a fun game inspired by the story of a blogger named Frank who saved an injured crab, so his deeds have spread in the crab world.

The main character of the game is an injured crab, which unfortunately has only one leg left, so it is desperate to get help, and it just learn that Frank is fishing nearby, so you set out to find Frank.

You need to control the only remaining leg of the crab in the game to go all the way, across various obstacles, to reach the final destination, although the game is very simple, you only need to move the mouse to control the behavior of the crab, but the overall game process will be very tortuous, after all, it only has one leg.
